scope: Installed native Codex0.169 default owner resolution plus ephemeral per-thread policy projection controls; no coding turn, selected-profile support or Rig launch conversion claim
limits: Not wired into WebMux creation; a snapshot is not permission to launch, readiness or coding/recovery evidence.
Actual end-to-end resolver acceptance is default CLI configuration on macOS ARM64; other policy cases use documented ephemeral per-thread native overrides and verify projection only.

Native Codex0.169 app-server rejects --profile. The resolver refuses selected configuration profiles; it never substitutes default configuration. Temporary profile admission failure is retained and excluded from positive evidence.
Named/inherited permission graphs, granular approvals, non-user reviewers, non-OpenAI providers and accounts without stable native ChatGPT user/workspace IDs refuse.

The creation adapter still must preserve provider execution environment and revalidate its plan before dispatch. Rig-generated writable directories must be suppressed or the workspace-write case refused.
The helper uses native account/read; it does not open/copy auth files itself. Raw account IDs, email, credentials, native stderr and arbitrary config contents are excluded from the returned plan.
